gumtree_entries.description: UPDATED o1 -> i1: This file was automatically generated by EvoSuite Mon Jun 15 04:51:30 GMT 2026
ADDED i2: Merging a filter whose shape needs more bit maps than the target filter can hold is rejected: the source filter (shape fromKM(1097, 5335)) produces more maps th
ADDED i4: processBitMapPairs returns false when the supplied predicate reports false for the first pair of bit maps it is given.
ADDED i5: A freshly created filter trivially contains itself, and characteristics() is 0.
ADDED i6: An empty filter does not contain a bit map extractor that has a bit set.
ADDED i7: Merging an IndexExtractor whose index (295) is out of the shape's range [0, 295) is rejected.
ADDED i9: Merging another BloomFilter of the same shape succeeds and returns true.
ADDED i10: Merging a BitMapExtractor that sets a bit above the shape's bit limit (295) is rejected.
ADDED i12: Merging a filter with itself as a BitMapExtractor succeeds and returns true.
ADDED i13: Merging an empty filter with itself as an IndexExtractor sets no bits, so the filter stays empty and merge returns true (matching isEmpty()).
ADDED i14: A newly created filter is empty.
ADDED i15: The bit map array length matches the number of longs required by the shape (18 maps for shape fromNM(1110, 1110)).
ADDED i16: clear() leaves the filter with characteristics() equal to 0.
ADDED i17: Merging a Hasher sets bits, so the filter is no longer empty and merge returns the opposite of isEmpty().
ADDED i18: estimateIntersection of a filter with itself runs without error and leaves characteristics() at 0.
ADDED i19: A filter always contains itself when viewed as an IndexExtractor.
